_description: hydroacoustic dataset. Each sample = 8-ch float32 WAV + JSON metadata.
class: ML class name: Sub_Heavy | Sub_Fast | Sub_Stealth | Sub_Rusty | Sub_Medium | Dolphin | OceanNoise
sources: array of active sources; each = { class, azimuth_deg }. OceanNoise has empty sources.

params_Dolphin.f_start_min: whistle start freq lower bound, Hz
params_Dolphin.f_start_max: whistle start freq upper bound, Hz
params_Dolphin.f_end_min: whistle end freq lower bound, Hz
params_Dolphin.f_end_max: whistle end freq upper bound, Hz

params_OceanNoise._note: ocean noise only, no active source
